scope: Live draft for a shared development case; no approval, execution, artifact score or competitive result.

task.title: Synthetic invoice-adjustments
task.description: Read input.json. For each invoice calculate balanceCents = billedCents minus all settled payments minus all approved credits; ignore pending payments and rejected credits. Negative balances must remain negative. Output artifacts/result.json as {"invoices":[{"id":string,"balanceCents":integer}],"totalBalanceCents":integer}. Sort invoices by id ascending. Include every invoice and no extra fields. Do not change input.json.

commands.command: mkdir -p artifacts && node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const input=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("input.json","utf8"));const invs=input.invoices||input;const out=invs.map(inv=>{let bal=inv.billedCents;for(const p of (inv.payments||[])){if(p.status==="settled")bal-=p.amountCents;}for(const c of (inv.credits||[])){if(c.status==="approved")bal-=c.amountCents;}return {id:inv.id,balanceCents:bal};});out.sort((a,b)=>a.id<b.id?-1:a.id>b.id?1:0);const total=out.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.balanceCents,0);fs.writeFileSync("artifacts/result.json",JSON.stringify({invoices:out,totalBalanceCents:total}));'

node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const input=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("input.json","utf8"));const res=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("artifacts/result.json","utf8"));const invs=input.invoices||input;const exp=invs.map(inv=>{let bal=inv.billedCents;for(const p of (inv.payments||[])){if(p.status==="settled")bal-=p.amountCents;}for(const c of (inv.credits||[])){if(c.status==="approved")bal-=c.amountCents;}return {id:inv.id,balanceCents:bal};}).sort((a,b)=>a.id<b.id?-1:a.id>b.id?1:0);const expTotal=exp.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.balanceCents,0);const fail=m=>{console.error("FAIL: "+m);process.exit(1);};if(!res||typeof res!=="object")fail("result not object");const keys=Object.keys(res).sort().join(",");if(keys!=="invoices,totalBalanceCents")fail("bad top-level keys: "+keys);if(!Array.isArray(res.invoices))fail("invoices not array");if(res.invoices.length!==exp.length)fail("count mismatch "+res.invoices.length+" vs "+exp.length);for(let i=0;i<exp.length;i++){const a=res.invoices[i],b=exp[i];const ak=Object.keys(a).sort().join(",");if(ak!=="balanceCents,id")fail("bad invoice keys at "+i+": "+ak);if(a.id!==b.id)fail("id mismatch at "+i);if(!Number.isInteger(a.balanceCents))fail("non-integer balance at "+i);if(a.balanceCents!==b.balanceCents)fail("balance mismatch at "+i+" id="+a.id+" got "+a.balanceCents+" want "+b.balanceCents);}for(let i=1;i<res.invoices.length;i++){if(res.invoices[i-1].id>res.invoices[i].id)fail("not sorted at "+i);}if(!Number.isInteger(res.totalBalanceCents))fail("total not integer");if(res.totalBalanceCents!==expTotal)fail("total mismatch got "+res.totalBalanceCents+" want "+expTotal);const sum=res.invoices.reduce((s,x)=>s+x.balanceCents,0);if(sum!==res.totalBalanceCents)fail("total != sum of balances");console.log("OK: "+res.invoices.length+" invoices, total "+res.totalBalanceCents);'
